title: H^n of a closed disc in an n-plane: H^n(T ∩ B_r(0)) = ω_n r^n
statement: For N, n ∈ ℕ, T ∈ G(N,n) (Grassmannian N n) and r ∈ ℝ with r ≥ 0: μHE[n](T.plane ∩ closedBall 0 r) = unitBallVolume n · ofReal(r)^n, i.e. H^n(T ∩ B_r(0)) = ω_n r^n. Here H^n = μHE[n] is Mathlib's Euclidean Hausdorff measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N, and ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the Lebesgue measure of the open unit ball of ℝ^n = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n).
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (T : Grassmannian N n) (r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((T.plane : Set (Euclidean N)) ∩ closedBall 0 r) = unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal r ^ n
